title: Orienta: Console pathing and compact runway for rapid workspace switching
creator: Ava Patel
description: Problem: As teams grow usage across multiple projects and Dedicated/Private deployments, engineers get lost switching between dashboards, rollouts, and cost views. Current sidebar is deep and static, and the workspace switch flow requires multiple clicks and context rehydration. Goal: Prototype a lightweight pathing layer ("compact runway") that surfaces high-frequency destinations, preserves context during workspace swaps, and exposes rollouts/cost lenses inline to reduce SLO-impacting navigation churn. This ticket covers concept sketches, Figma prototypes, accessibility review, engineering feasibility sync, and an experiment plan for telemetry-driven ordering.
background: Recent customer feedback and telemetry show 42% of console sessions include more than two workspace swaps per day and that 18% of navigation failures generate support tickets. PM growth hypothesis: reducing workspace-switch friction by 30% will increase daily active project workflows and lower support load for ‘wrong workspace’ errors. Product requests include quick access to per-route cost breakdowns, canary rollout toggles, and a compact history view tied to recent traces.
design_decisions: Introduce a compact runway: a top-aligned transient surface that expands from the console header and shows prioritized destinations (projects, dashboards, rollouts, cost-lens views)
Use telemetry to compute priority order (recent, frequent, SLA-sensitive routes) with local caching to keep latency under 40ms for runway open animation
Preserve route state during swaps by serializing visible filters and last active tab to local storage and passing them through the workspace switch handshake
Inline rollout toggles for routes that have active canaries; toggles are contextual and require a confirmation modal for cross-workspace changes
Expose a keyboard-first quick-jump (Cmd/Ctrl+K) that mirrors runway ordering and includes fuzzy search of dashboards and routes
engineering_feedback: Eng raised concerns about serializing large dashboard state; recommended whitelisting only filters and selected time ranges
Runtime team suggested an API contract to expose lightweight route manifests for priority calculation (route_id, sso_scope, sla_flag)
Performance ask: runway open/close must not trigger new model loads or heavy queries; prefer cached manifests + background refresh
accessibility_notes: Runway must be fully keyboard operable with aria-live updates for priority changes
High contrast and clearly labeled focus states required for quick-jump items
Confirm modal for rollout toggles needs screen-reader-friendly copy and undo affordance
reviews: PM review (Lina Gomez): Likes telemetry-first ordering; asked for success metric that ties reduced navigation time to rollout adoption
Security review (Ravi Menon): No new data exfiltration, but recommended an audit entry when running cross-workspace canary toggles
Engineering review (Sofia Alvarez): Prototype looks implementable with a new route-manifest endpoint; requested a small spike to estimate cache invalidation complexity
tradeoffs: Aggressive caching improves runway latency but increases risk of showing stale cost numbers; mitigated by a subtle stale badge and background refresh
Showing rollout toggles inline speeds operations but increases surface area for accidental changes; mitigated via confirmation + audit logs
Reducing nav depth simplifies frequent flows but may hide low-frequency admin routes; solution: an "all destinations" view inside runway
acceptance_criteria: Clickable runway prototype in Figma with defined motion spec and accessibility annotations
Design handoff package (tokens, spacing, component states) uploaded to Drive and referenced in the PR
Spike deliverable from Eng estimating route-manifest and cache invalidation (<= 3 days)
Telemetry plan: define events for runway_open, quick_jump_select, workspace_swap_success, rollout_toggle_confirm, and baseline metrics for current navigation time
A/B experiment plan to measure 30% reduction in median workspace switch time before rollout to 10% of users
open_questions: Should runway persist across sign-outs or be scoped per session? (Security favors session-only)
What thresholds trigger showing cost-lens inline vs linking to full cost view?
How do we surface multi-tenant permissions in runway without cluttering the UI?
next_steps: Finalize Figma prototype and annotate motion specs (owner: Jonah)
Eng spike to implement route-manifest and a minimal cache layer (owner: Priya Shah)
Draft telemetry events and hook up 30-day baseline dashboards (owner: Data Platform team)
Run accessibility pass with Accessibility Guild and incorporate feedback into final handoff
